# summarizeEvents

open suspend override fun [summarizeEvents](summarize-events.html)(events: [List](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-list/index.html)<[Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html)>): [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html)?

Compacts the given [events](summarize-events.html) into a single [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html).

Returns `null` if compaction failed. Otherwise returns a new [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html) that must carry the summary on its [com.google.adk.kt.events.EventActions.compaction](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-actions/compaction.html) field; the original events are not modified by this call.

#### Return

A new compacted [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html) or `null` if no summary was produced.

#### Parameters

 _events_

The events to summarize.
